task.ques: How many MLB teams are there and list all the teams with 'City' in their name.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: MLB has 30 teams. The only team with “City” in its name is the Kansas City Royals.
Evidence: ESPN’s MLB Teams directory lists six divisions of five teams each (30 total), and Kansas City Royals is the sole name containing “City.” Source: https://www.espn.com/mlb/teams (accessed October 28, 2026). Screenshot: final.png.
